llm.summary: This is a straightforward background-check checklist skill, but it handles sensitive candidate information that users should provide only with authorization and minimization.

dimensions.detail: The requested input is a resume up to 10,000 characters, which is proportionate for checklist generation. The skill says inference is local, data is not sent to third parties, session data is cleared, and candidate personal information is not saved; users should still minimize submitted PII.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no executable scripts, package installs, remote payload retrieval, or dependency behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation description is specific to preparing to hire a candidate and generating a background-check checklist and question template. It could be more explicit about non-use cases, but the artifact does not show hidden goals, instruction hijacking, or unrelated authority.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, credential use, privilege escalation, tool modification, local indexing, or system mutation behavior is present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose and behavior are coherent: it turns candidate resume content into education, work-history, and project verification checklists, questions, risk notes, and a report template. The input is inherently sensitive hiring data, but that is expected for the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before using this skill, make sure the candidate has authorized the background check and provide only the information needed to generate the checklist. Redact unnecessary identifiers and avoid submitting government IDs, financial details, health information, family details, or unrelated personal data.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The privacy concern is valid user guidance because the skill processes candidate resumes, but the artifact discloses local inference, no third-party sharing, no saved candidate information, session clearing, and notes that background checks require candidate authorization; this does not justify Review by itself.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger scope could be more precise, but the description is limited to hiring-stage background-check checklist and question-template generation, and no high-impact tool authority or hidden behavior is attached to activation.
